gui.neoorigins.creator.stub: Iccer %s  yettwaselkam deg tasurift n 2.1 tamaynut
origins.neoorigins.human.name: Amdan
origins.neoorigins.human.description: Amdan ameɣtu, ur yesɛi ara tazmert tameẓlit maca yesɛa tizemmar meqqren.
origins.neoorigins.merling.name: Merling
origins.neoorigins.merling.description: Agdud n waman i d-ilulen deg ugaraw yeldin  yettneffis aman, yettɛumu s sshala, maca s leɛqel, yeqqur di lqaɛa.
origins.neoorigins.avian.name: Avian
origins.neoorigins.avian.description: Aferfir aḥerfi i d-iṣubben s ttawil, ur yettaggad ara tiɣzi, yettmuqqul amaḍal seg usawen.
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.name: Blazeling
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.description: Ilul-d seg tmes n lqaɛa  yuli-d s lkuffa, yuɣal-d deg tillas, maca yessečča-t waman d ugeffur.
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.name: Elytrian
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.description: Amsadur n ufeggag aḥerfi  yettafeg deg yigenni, ur t-ttnal ara lǧehd n tnekra, maca d amecṭuḥ yerna ur yezmir ara ad yawi tajerrart ẓẓayen.
origins.neoorigins.enderian.name: Enderian
origins.neoorigins.enderian.description: Ilul-d deg tegzirin n beṛṛa n Taggara  yettawi iman-is akken i s-yehwa, yettawi iman-is deg lexṣaṣ, yetteddu akken ur t-ttwalin ara yimdanen. Aman sserɣayen am usemmiḍ.
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.name: Aṛaknid
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.description: Iɣewwaṛen n tissisin i d-yettalin ɣef lḥiḍ, i d-yettḍeyyiɛen i yeεdawen s uẓeṭṭa, i d-yettḍeyyiɛen s yiɣewwaṛen-nsen  d wid i d-yetteddun ɣef tmenya n yiḍarren deg umaḍal.
origins.neoorigins.shulk.name: Shulk
origins.neoorigins.shulk.description: Yeṭṭef-d am uɛekkaz  yekkes-d ɣef tuyat, yeqqel ɣer tqecwalt mi ara t-id-iḥerrek yiwen, yerra-d iɛdawen ɣer yigenni s uḥemmal. S leɛqel, maca ur yettsellik ara.
origins.neoorigins.phantom.name: Phantom
origins.neoorigins.phantom.description: Taɣawsa-nni n tmuɣli  tettafeg deg yiḍ ɣef wafriwen n ulitra, tettawi-d lǧehd seg tmenɣiwin, maca tesserɣ-it yiṭij, ur yezmir ara ad yesgunfu.
power.neoorigins.merling_water_breathing: Yettneffis ddaw waman i lebda, yettwali akken ilaq deg waman war tagut.
power.neoorigins.merling_aquatic_speed.d: Iteddu s tɣawla mi ara yettɛummu.
power.neoorigins.merling_night_vision.de: Yettwali akken iwata deg talqayt n tillas. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.merling_land_slowdown.d: Iteddu s 10% s ttawil deg wakal.
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.name: Yeqqur
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.descr: Aḍu yettruẓu ticki ur tesɛiḍ ara aman: ma teqqimeḍ aṭas deg tjumma, ad teffneḍ. Lgerra, tiɣmert n waman, aman yettneffsen neɣ abadu urmiden i d-yezzin ɣer tama-k, akk ad t-ṭṭfen.
power.neoorigins.avian_no_fall_damage.de: Ur d-yettḍurru ara mi ara yeɣli  iferrawen ṭṭfen aḍu.
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.name: Tuɣalin s leɛqel
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.descrip: Yettwakkes: iteddu s ttawil d akessar. Yettwasens s lexṣas. Tamawt: tuccḍiwin tiḥerfiyin ḥwaǧent tuccḍa s wudem amagnu, ihi eǧǧ-it yensa ɣer crit.
Yesseqdac 75% drus n tnezmart seg tigawin meṛṛa.
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.name: Tamuɣli taḥerfit
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.descri: Allen yeqquren  ttwalint cwiṭ deg tillas.
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.name: Iɣsan ilemsen
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.desc: -1 wul (-2 HP afellay). Tafekka tafessast, akatar afessas.
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.name: Aɣelluy n tfelwit
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.descr: Ḍegger s tazzla n wafriwen. Ulac lexlaṣ n laẓ.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_fire_immunity: Ur d-tettḍurru ara tmes, lva, lmagma d tmes  times sdaxel tettarra-d tiririt i tmes deg berra.
+3 n wulawen (+6 HP afellay). Tifelwiyin n uẓru ttɛeyyinent tafekka.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_nether_born.d: D arurad deg akal agejdan  iteddu s zzerb ticki deg Nether (ulac tignit n ugmuḍ yettbanen).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_stone_fists.d: S yifassen-iw kan i ttɣellibeɣ deg tfesna n uẓru  ṛṛẓeɣ aẓru, tiɣmert, d uẓru n uẓru war ifecka.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_internal_heat: Times tagensant tesserɣay  laẓ ittruḥ-d s zzerb s 25%.
Aman d issem  ttḍurrun azal n 1.5 deg tasint mi ara ilin deg waman neɣ deg ugeffur.
Tiṭṭawin yettwafeṣṣlen ɣer yifra-azeggaɣ  ttwalin akken iwata deg tillas. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.name: Firebolt
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.desc: Ḍegger tiɣri n tmes tamecṭuḥt ɣer tama i tettwaliḍ. Yeswa 2 n yiɣes. 4 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_elytra_boost.d: Ad d-yernu tazzla n tɣawla ticki yettwasenker s elytra.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.name: Afrag agaman
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.descrip: Zzi am useqdac n elytra  ulac aferdis yettwasran. Senned ɣef tumert mi ara teɣliḍ akken ad tferreẓeḍ afriwen-ik.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight_speed.d: +30% n tɣawla n ufeggag  igenni yekna fell-ak.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.name: Aɣelluy n tfesna
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.descri: Ur yettḍurru ara mi ara yeɣli.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_kinetic.des: Ur d-ttḍurrun ara wuguren n temhelt-elytra-collision  ttafeg deg lḥiḍ war ayen ara d-yeḍrun.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.name: Akatar afessas
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.descri: Iɣsan n wegḍiḍ d ilem - sin n wulawen i d-yeqqimen.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_heavy_armor: Ur yezmir ara ad yawi iɣallen ẓẓayen
Ur tezmireḍ ara ad telseḍ isɣallen n wuzzal, n wuṛeɣ, n uẓemẓi neɣ n netherite  n uglim neɣ n uzrar kan. Igrawen ilaq ad qqimen fessusen.
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.name: Stampede
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.descri: Smiren ɣer sdat ɣef yiqejjiren-ik. Yeswa 2 n tfesniwin. 4 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.name: Aẓar n lqaεa
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.descr: Wwet lqaɛa s tgecrar n wuzzal  4 n wuguren akked usebɣes II i 4 n tsinin i yiɛdawen meṛṛa iqerben deg uzgen n 5 n yiḥedran. Yeswa 3 n tfesna. 7 n tsinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.enderian_ender_eyes.des: Endermen ur k-d-ttwalin ara  muqel-iten-id war ma tεeddaḍ-d fell-asen.
power.neoorigins.enderian_projectile_dod: Azal n 50% akken ad yeqleɛ ubrid-is u ad yerwel mi ara t-yewwet uḍebsi.
power.neoorigins.enderian_water_damage.d: Yettḍurru s 2 n tikkal i tasint seg unermes d waman neɣ ageffur.
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.name: warp ender
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.descr: Azen ɣer wanda tettwaliḍ  alamma d 50 n yiḥedran. Yeswa 2 n tnezmart. 3 n tasinin n usebded.
Ṭṭef iman-ik deg yal taqacuct tabdidt  tekki ɣef lḥiḍ akken ad teṭṭfeḍ, neggez akken ad taliḍ, ṭṭef s tuffra akken ad teqqimeḍ deg umkan-ik. Ur ttruẓuḍ ara mi ara teṭṭfeḍ.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_affinit: Iteddu deg uẓeṭṭa n tissisin war ma yeṣṣubb-iten, yerna yettṛuẓu-ten deg teswiɛt.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_entity_group.d: Yettwaḥsab d arthropod  lexsara-nniḍen seg yimrigen Bane of Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.d: Iɣerracen n umennuɣ ttarran-d ssem  iswiyen ttarran-d ssem i 3 n tsinin.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_project: Yettḍeyyiḍ-d aẓeṭṭa n tcacit i d-yettawin iman-is ɣef uẓeṭṭa-nniḍen, yeṭṭerḍeq ayen akk ɣef ara d-iṣubb. Yeswa 2 n yiɣil.
power.neoorigins.shulk_natural_armor.des: Ammesten ameɣlal I  shell yessebleɛ tiɣriwin ara d-yeǧǧen tafekka taḥlawant ad teṛẓ.
power.neoorigins.shulk_slow_movement.des: Iteddu s ttawil ugar n tannumi.
Urmid: serreḥ i tuffɣa n tqecwalt  iɛdawen iqerben ttεeffin d asawen i 3 n tsinin. Yeswa 2 n tesɣent. 8 n tsinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.shulk_shell_retreat.des: Urmid: ad iruḥ ɣer tqecwalt-ik sakin ad d-iban alamma d 12 n yiḥedran. Yeswa 3 n teswiɛin. 10 n tsinin n usebded.
power.neoorigins.shulk_levitation_immuni: Ur d-yettenneffu ara  taqecwalt-ik ad k-teṭṭef deg uẓar mi ara d-uɣalen yiɣerdayen.
power.neoorigins.phantom_night_vision.de: Yezmer ad iwali akken iwata deg tillas tummidt. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.phantom_water_breathing: Ur yeḥwaǧ ara ad yesnuffes. Yezmer ad yidir i lebda ddaw waman.
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.name: Talɣa n uḥeckul
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.descriptio: Yettban-d ur yettban ara, yettmerriḥ mebla taẓayt.
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.name: Tiferkiyin n ugdil
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.descript: Zzi am useqdac n elytra  ulac aferdis yettwasran. Senned ɣef tumert mi ara teɣliḍ akken ad tferreẓeḍ afriwen-ik.
power.neoorigins.phantom_elytra_boost.de: Yettawi-d s tazzla mi ara yuli yiwen  ifantumen ttruḥun s waṭas s wafriwen-nsen.
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.name: Moonplate
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.desc: Azbu i ddaw n wayyur (d iḍ kan)  tafat n wayyur teffer-d talɣa n ugdil. Tafat n wass tekkes-d ammesten.
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.name: Asekles n teṛwiḥin
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.desc: Seḥlu 1 HP yal mi ara tenɣeḍ amdan.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.name: War taẓayt
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.descrip: Ur yettḍurru ara mi ara yeɣli  tafekka n yinesnasen ur d-tettṣubbu ara.
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.name: Sunburn
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.descrip: Yettaṭṭaf times, yettḍurru s 1.5 deg tasint deg tafat n yiṭij srid.
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.name: Talɣa tarẓagant
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.descrip: -2 n wulawen (-4 HP afellay). Tafekka n tagut teshel i usfeḍ.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.name: Tugdi ur nettnuddum
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.descri: Ur tezmireḍ ara ad tegneḍ  iḍ d aḥric-ik.
origins.neoorigins.feline.name: Amcic
origins.neoorigins.feline.description: Amcic d arurad, yettwalin mliḥ deg yiḍ, yettneggiz akken ilaq - ad d-iṣubb ɣef iḍarren-is, ad yezzuɣur ɣer yizamaren d yiɣerdayen, maca ur iḥemmel ara aman yerna ad yerɣ s tɣawla.
power.neoorigins.feline_no_fall_damage.d: Yettṣubbu yal tikelt s tɣellist. Ur yettwaɣ ara ma yeɣli.
power.neoorigins.feline_night_vision.des: Yezmer ad iwali akken iwata deg tillas. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.name: Agile
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.desc: Iteddu s 10% s zzerb ɣef umdan amagnu.
power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.name: Talwit n Predator
